name: the_state_reads_how_a_mate_is_set
why: REPORT 8CD843 N63 (round 20, 28/10/2026). The owner mated the assembly again by hand (15 distances became 5 coincident, 4 width and 1 distance) and the round could not read how: «mates_list» gave the kind, the components and nothing else. Now each mate says its «alignment» in the words «mate» takes, its «value» (the dimension of a distance or an angle) and «entity_kinds», the kind of entity on each component.
defect_caught: An alignment read with the other name of the same number (swMateAlign_e gives swAlignSAME and swMateAlignANTI_ALIGNED the value 1); a distance mate read with no value or with the value in metres; an entity of a face mate read as something else.

expect.why: the mate is there, counted on both components, as in «one_mate_is_not_enough»

THE ALIGNMENT ASKED, READ BACK IN THE SAME WORD: «mate» writes «opposite» as swMateAlignANTI_ALIGNED (1), and IMate2.Alignment gives it back. swAlignSAME is 1 as well: a reading by that name would say the opposite of what was asked
two faces, one on each component: IMateEntity2.ReferenceType2 gives swSelFACES (2)

expect.tolerance_why: measured on the two faces: the right face of the cover 10 mm beyond the right face of the base

expect.why: the second mate of the tree
the other word, on the other mate: «aligned» is swMateAlignALIGNED (0)

expect.tolerance_why: THE VALUE OF THE MATE, IN MM: its first display dimension (IMate2.DisplayDimension2, index 0) read as every dimension of the state, 0.010 m written as 10 mm

expect.why: the first mate is still read the same after the second
